operand_roles.use: reads a value operand (register or constant)
operand_roles.immediate: a VM value embedded in the op itself rather than read from a register or constant
operand_roles.unify_def: a destination register the op's result is unified into
operand_roles.clobber_def: a destination register the op overwrites without unification
operand_roles.const: plain data embedded in the op; not a VM value
operand_roles.jump: a branch target within the same procedure

operand_kinds.register: a register index (u32); absent when optional and not supplied
operand_kinds.value: a register index or a constant-pool index (register-or-constant); absent when optional and not supplied
operand_kinds.value_imm: an embedded VM value of any kind (cell or scalar)
operand_kinds.cell:VUniqueString: an embedded reference to a VUniqueString cell
operand_kinds.cell:VPackage: an embedded reference to a VPackage cell
operand_kinds.cell:VArray: an embedded reference to a VArray cell
operand_kinds.cell:VArchetype: an embedded reference to a VArchetype cell
operand_kinds.cell:VProcedure: an embedded reference to a VProcedure cell; null when optional and not supplied
operand_kinds.label: a branch target within the same procedure
operand_kinds.live_range: a pair of u32 (Begin, End) positions in the procedure's op stream
operand_kinds.failure_context_id: a u32 identifying a failure context within its procedure
operand_kinds.asset_path: a top-level asset path: package name and asset name
operand_kinds.class_ref_ic: inline-cache reference to a VClass cell; null in any emitted or serialized op

capture_flags.incoming_effect_token: a parked op also saves the effect token in force when it began executing
capture_flags.return_effect_token: a parked op also saves the effect token it must produce when it completes
capture_flags.batched_refs: a parked op also saves the current batch of pending reference writes
